problem: When nltl:shipExposedToIceAccretion is true, nltl:hasProtectedItem has no sh:minCount, so a ship can have no protected-item inventory and still satisfy the conditional branch.
required_change: Add sh:minCount 1 to the conditional nltl:hasProtectedItem property constraint, or otherwise require the protected-item inventory when applicability is true.
regression_guard: Preserve the true-applicability requirement for at least one validated protected item.

location: MainShape / conditional sh:or true branch / protectedItemCategory
problem: The candidate permits any set of protected-item categories but does not require coverage of all six obligatory categories: escape route, muster station, embarkation area, survival craft, launching appliance, and survival-craft access.
required_change: Add a conditional complete-coverage constraint requiring at least one protected item for each of the six permitted category values, with each such item linked to at least one nltl:hasIceSnowRemovalOrPreventionMeans value.
regression_guard: Preserve all six canonical protected-item categories and their per-item ice/snow removal or prevention means requirement.
